verdict.rationale: Vendor docs state llamafile ships GPU acceleration for AMD and Vulkan among its backends, implying a Vulkan path could accelerate AMD GPUs, but no documentation or community evidence explicitly confirms that the Vulkan backend avoids requiring a ROCm install for AMD cards. Community reports (e.g., comm-13) discuss GPU offload issues generally but do not address AMD/Vulkan/ROCm specifics. Missing for 10: explicit docs on Vulkan-as-ROCm-alternative for AMD, and hands-on confirmation from an AMD GPU user that it works without ROCm.
